name: prove-lyne-core-playback-library-value
title: Prove Lyne core playback and library value
creator: Asaiuta
notes: Electron/WebAudio baseline implemented and evidence verdict recorded. Previously blocked cargo bench commands pass on formal retry. Active playback control probe now passes 9/9 controls during playback; deterministic one-track fixture scan indexes WAV metadata and sidecar cover. Real-library benchmark passes on the user-supplied 594-file / 23.14 GB library. A hot-path fix now avoids per-file canonicalize on fresh local scans while preserving snapshot fallback compatibility. Warm-cache rerun: Lyne default 2 workers indexed 593 tracks in 1.180 s with about 33 MB peak RSS; SPlayer native scanner rerun indexed 590 in 2.175 s with about 93 MB peak RSS and higher sampled CPU. Task remains in progress for final verification/wrap-up and UI/release proof follow-ups.
